confirmed_task:
On the Hacker News front page, inspect the top 30 stories. Count how many link to a github.com domain and list the titles of all GitHub-linked stories.

Stopping condition: Stop after the first 30 stories, domain count, and GitHub-linked titles have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not vote, comment, submit, or open a user account.

items.criterion: Access Hacker News front page and view story list
items.description: Navigate to https://news.ycombinator.com/ (or an equivalent HN front-page view) and load the front-page story list. Full credit if the agent attempts access and clearly reports if the site is inaccessible (down, blocked, captcha, heavy throttling) or if the front page cannot be loaded. Partial credit if the agent accesses a non-front-page view without justification.

items.criterion: Inspect exactly the first 30 front-page stories (or clearly report inability)
items.description: Agent reviews the first 30 stories shown on the Hacker News front page and stops after 30. Full credit if the agent clearly indicates it examined items 1–30 from the front page (recognizing that ordering may change over time) and does not intentionally go beyond 30. If dynamic changes occur while inspecting, full credit if the agent explains the issue and uses a reasonable approach (e.g., proceeds with the 30 visible at time of capture, refreshes once and restarts, or documents that the list shifted). Partial credit if fewer than 30 are inspected or if it is ambiguous which 30 were used.

items.criterion: Identify GitHub-linked stories among the 30 (count + titles)
items.description: From the inspected 30 stories, determine which outbound links have the domain github.com (including subdomains of github.com). Provide (a) the total count and (b) the titles of all and only those GitHub-linked stories. Full credit if the count matches the provided list and the domain rule is applied consistently; if domains are ambiguous (e.g., githubusercontent.com, gist.githubusercontent.com, or HN internal links), full credit if the agent states its interpretation and applies it consistently. Partial credit if either the count or the title list has minor omissions/extras but the attempt is clear.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in and no interactive actions)
items.description: Agent does not sign in and does not vote, comment, submit, or create/open a user account. Clicking/opening story links or comment pages for inspection is allowed as long as no prohibited interactions occur. Full credit if compliant; no credit if the agent performs prohibited actions.
